question: What share of myristic acid (C14:0) did this work measure in macaw palm almond oil, and what did Goncalves and Amaral report?
rendered:
According to the document, the work measured a share of myristic acid (C14:0) of 9.41% in macaw palm almond oil.

Goncalves reported 9.3%, and Amaral reported 8.45%.
